learning_start: pool504 complete training state from November 23

training.opponents: Same-seed postflop, each non-traverser assigned once per traversal: current 1/2, each of 300/360/420 1/6. All seats retain the frozen specialist480 preflop.
training.replay: Keep the parent reservoir, sampler weighting, root and strategy memories and all RNG streams. Same per-round optimizer initialization as the source.
training.decision: Finish the one fixed window without intermediate-score rollback. Stop on execution, nonfinite, identity or training-integrity failure. Report auxiliary average fidelity separately as in the source.

external.primary: Public mixture528 minus mixture504, paired two-sided 95% interval. Lower bound above zero supports improvement and upper below zero supports deterioration. Otherwise direction unresolved. Compare against fixed specialist480 separately.
external.secondary: Matched scores by field, seed and policy form. Native auxiliary averages have their own preflop and are diagnostic; never call them full history. No synthetic four-snapshot policy at 480.

crossplay.design: All 3x3 directed 1-vs-5 lineups with same-seed policies. Pair all fields on original cards and assign independent hand-private snapshot slots per physical seat.
crossplay.decision: Show reciprocal directed entries and matched conditional contrasts. Only claim a strict sampled cycle when simultaneous intervals support all its edges in both roles. No exact best response evaluation.

units: bb/100; average six rotated seats and three fixed seeds inside each original card before inference
